scientific_integrity: Analytic proof accompanies 135 exact finite-field diagnostics; computations are not treated as universal certification; literature priority is qualified, with older general period theory not fully inspected.
scientific_limitations: Exact full-configuration period for finite spatial ring and finite inner-layer truncation, constant step, prime field; neither arbitrary coefficient rules nor individual orbit-period distributions are covered.
title: A prime-power period law for finite truncations of a triangular cellular automaton
